name: study-hebrew-letters
description: Study the twenty-two Hebrew letters as mystical symbols. Covers letter forms, numerical values, elemental/planetary/zodiacal correspondences, Sefer Yetzirah attributions, and contemplative letter meditation techniques. Use when studying a specific letter's mystical dimensions beyond its linguistic function, learning the Sefer Yetzirah classification of mothers, doubles, and simples, needing correspondences for a letter's element, planet, or zodiac sign, practicing Hebrew letter visualization or chanting meditation, or studying Tree of Life paths and their assigned letters.
